content.title: About
content.content: Rice, white with carrots is a dish made from boiled white rice mixed with grated or finely diced carrots. It is often served as a side or a light meal, providing carbohydrates and vitamins.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White rice is one of the most consumed grains worldwide.
Carrots add a bright color and natural sweetness to the dish.
Rice and carrot combinations are common in Asian cuisines, such as Japanese onigiri.
Carrots are rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
When stored properly, rice can retain its quality for up to a year.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Rice provides a quick source of energy thanks to its high carbohydrate content.

items.title: Vitamin A from carrots
items.content: Beta‑carotene in carrots supports vision, immunity, and skin health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The dish contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Mineral source
items.content: Rice supplies magnesium and phosphorus, important for bones and muscles.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Well‑cooked rice is gentle on the stomach, beneficial for those with digestive issues.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice can cause a rapid rise in blood sugar, so people with diabetes should monitor portions.

items.title: Low fiber content
items.content: Unlike whole‑grain varieties, white rice provides little dietary fiber.

items.title: Carrot allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to carrots.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish as a side to meat, fish, or vegetable stews. It can also be used in salads, rolls, or as a quick lunch base. Add spices, soy sauce, or herbs for extra flavor if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store cooked rice in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. For longer storage, freeze in portion‑sized bags for up to 2 months. Reheat to at least 75 °C before consumption.
